column2: An irritable adult complains angrily when a ball rolls near their chair, while the apologetic child waits at a distance.
A tailor cuts a coat's front edge diagonally away from the waist, showing the newly sloping cut and cloth offcut.
A close view of a leaf highlights its thin protective outer skin, with a small peeled-back edge above the softer tissue.
An adorable puppy peeks from a soft blanket, with bright eyes, tiny paws and a relaxed friendly expression.
A single glossy ceramic tile is a clear cyan blue-green, with its broad colored surface facing the viewer.
A group of simple blue glass beads shares the same rich blue hue, with no lettering or additional colors.
Several computers connect through visible network cables to a central router, with linked picture screens and no interface text.
A thermostat-controlled mechanical system senses room temperature and adjusts a heater, with a feedback connection visibly returning to the controller.
A robot corrects its grip using a pressure sensor, with a simple feedback loop joining the hand, sensor and controller.
A hand arranges three Cyrillic letter tiles, displaying the distinct forms Ж, Д and Я as the entire subject.
A dahlia flower forms a dense rounded head of layered pointed petals, above dark leaves and one closed bud.
A damask tablecloth folds across a table, revealing a woven floral pattern through alternating matte and shiny threads of one color.
A frustrated adult reacts to a snapped shoelace, clenching one hand and opening their mouth in an angry exclamation.
White dandruff flakes rest on dark hair and a black shoulder, with a hand gently brushing the shoulder clean.
A dapper adult walks briskly in a neatly fitted suit, with polished shoes, a tidy collar and an alert posture.
A globe highlights the international date line through the Pacific, with the two adjacent calendar dates shown on small cards.
A gardener works through a long day, with one clock-like sun arc over the same plot from sunrise to sunset.
A technician deactivates a machine by turning its main switch off, with the formerly moving belt now still.
An idle adult lounges in a hammock while unfinished household chores and unused tools accumulate around the garden.
A flyswatter kills a mosquito on a windowsill, with the tiny motionless insect beneath the mesh and no gore.
A female street tough kicks an empty can beside a shop, adopting an intimidating stance while pedestrians keep their distance.
A reckless adult neglects piled work to indulge in an extravagant late-night feast, with overturned cups and scattered game pieces.
A hand transfers a flower decal from backing paper onto a plain ceramic mug, peeling the thin carrier sheet away.
A glass decanter holds red wine, with a broad base, narrow neck and a stopper resting beside it.
A wooden ramp slopes upward from a flat floor, with its angled surface clearly contrasted against the horizontal ground.
A technician deconstructs a small clock into organized separate components, placing each gear and casing piece beside the opened mechanism.
A leaking bucket loses water drop by drop, with its low remaining water level and growing puddle clearly visible.
A dog defecates discreetly on grass while its owner waits with a cleanup bag, with no close anatomical detail.
A planner defers a scheduled task by moving its picture card to a later calendar square, leaving the first square empty.
A portable defibrillator sits in its open case, showing the unit, coiled electrode leads and sealed pad packets without procedural instructions.
A dishonest seller defrauds a customer with a broken watch concealed inside an attractive sealed gift box.
A dehumidifier collects water in its transparent lower tank, with damp room air drawn through its upper grille.
A proud visitor graciously agrees to help a child lift a fallen kite, bending down despite their initially stiff posture.
A surveyor delimits a garden plot using four boundary stakes and a taut rope, with the enclosed area clearly visible.
Citizens replace one ruler's elevated chair with an equal circular council table and a shared ballot box.
A teacher demonstrates that a magnet attracts iron nails, lifting them visibly while wooden pieces remain on the table.
A complete removable denture rests in a clear soaking cup, with its curved pink base and artificial teeth visible.
A dependent child clings to a caregiver's sleeve, unwilling to attempt a simple puzzle without the caregiver's hand guiding theirs.
Many houses in a village stand empty and shuttered, while only a few residents remain around the central well.
A well-composed adult walks with upright posture and controlled steps, holding a cup steadily while greeting a host politely.
A depositor hands a savings envelope to a bank teller, with a coin tray and closed safe visible behind the counter.
A deputation of three representatives presents a joint petition to a council, standing together before the meeting table.
A bicycle rear derailleur guides the chain between sprockets, with its two small pulley wheels and articulated arm clearly visible.
An official removes a restrictive barrier from a workshop entrance, allowing several new small businesses to begin operating.
A derisive spectator points and laughs at a beginner's uneven painting, while the beginner looks embarrassed beside the easel.
A dermatologist examines a patient's forearm with a magnifying light, with skin diagrams and a specimen tray nearby.
A formerly divided school entrance becomes shared, with the separating barrier removed and all children entering through the same doorway.
A deserter leaves a companion alone with a heavy shared load, slipping away while the companion struggles to hold it.
A supporting wedge is pulled from beneath a tall stack, making the structure lean and its top pieces wobble.
A controlled demolition collapses an empty derelict building into its cleared footprint, with distant barriers and no visible explosive mechanisms.
A detachable camera lens separates from the camera body, with the matching bayonet mounts facing each other across a small gap.
One decisive wooden wedge holds a heavy door firmly open, preventing its movement while all other objects remain irrelevant nearby.
A detractor disparages a craftsperson's careful work to a visitor, sneering and pointing while the maker remains unaware nearby.
A dewy spiderweb stretches between two leaves, with round clear droplets clinging to each fine silk strand.
A dexterous craftsperson threads a tiny needle and repairs intricate lace, with precise finger placement and a steady focused posture.
A fictional devil has small horns, a pointed tail and a mischievous grin, standing beside a simple trident without flames.
An old computer connects through a telephone modem, with the phone line and separate receiver visibly linked beside it.
A dictatorial ruler commands officials from a high throne, pointing imperiously while guards prevent anyone from speaking freely.
A die-hard repairer insists on using a worn manual tool, ignoring a practical new replacement offered beside the bench.
A nutritionally balanced tray contains grains, vegetables, beans and a measured portion of fish, arranged clearly for one meal.
A nutrition specialist plans a balanced meal with a client, comparing food portions beside a scale and fresh ingredient bowls.
A nutrition scholar studies food composition at a desk, arranging samples of grains, fruit and beans beside research charts.
A male and female peacock stand together, clearly showing the male's ornate train and the female's smaller subdued plumage.
A director oversees an organization from a management desk, coordinating three department representatives around one shared work plan.
A traveler finds an awkwardly oversized suitcase inconvenient on a narrow stairway, struggling where a smaller case would fit.
A referee disallows a goal by signaling a stoppage, while the ball remains in the net and players pause.
A mechanic disassembles a hand drill into separate gears, casing halves and handle, laying the parts neatly around the bench.
A skeptical listener doubts a fisher's exaggerated story, comparing the speaker's wide gesture with the tiny actual fish.
An accountant disburses wages into several workers' envelopes, handing each person their own payment from the cash tray.
A strict instructor requires students to align every tool precisely, checking the orderly bench while they wait attentively.
A record catalog displays a performer's albums as grouped cover thumbnails, beside matching vinyl sleeves and a storage shelf.
A disappointed child discovers a supposed treasure chest holds only pebbles, sitting stunned beside the open lid and discarded map.
A disgusted diner pushes away a spoiled dish, turning their face aside with a wrinkled nose and tight frown.
A once-smooth stone bust is disfigured by deep cracks and missing fragments, with fallen pieces gathered beneath its pedestal.
Several mismatched chairs and clashing table settings create visible disharmony around an otherwise neatly arranged dining table.
A floppy diskette lies beside its open protective sleeve, showing its square shell, metal shutter and sliding write-protect tab.
A mover dislocates a heavy cabinet from its original wall position, revealing the clean rectangular patch behind it.
A disloyal teammate secretly gives the opposing team their own side's hidden tactics folder, watching for witnesses over one shoulder.
An unfaithful retainer hands the castle key to an enemy, while the trusting ruler waits inside the guarded gate.
A snapped wooden puppet lies in separated sections, with its detached limb, torso and severed joining cords visible without gore.
A disorganized workshop mixes tools, fabric and hardware across every surface, leaving no clear place to work.
A careless mover disrupts an organized filing system, tipping sorted folders into one mixed heap across the floor.
A traveler loses their sense of direction inside a circular maze, turning uncertainly among several identical branching passages.
A worker denies responsibility for a spilled paint bucket, holding both palms outward while stepping away from the obvious mess.
A decorative ribbon is removed from a perfectly functioning tool, showing the unnecessary accessory set aside while the tool works.
A food distributor portions rice from one large pot into several waiting bowls, serving each person in turn.
An official takes property keys away from a distressed owner, removing their access while the locked house stands behind them.
A huge lampshade sits on an absurdly tiny lamp base, making the disproportion between top and support unmistakable.
Two disputants argue opposite sides of a boundary disagreement, pointing toward separate ends of the same disputed fence.
A race official removes a runner from the starting line after discovering illegal equipment, while eligible competitors remain in place.
A poorly regarded repair shop has broken returned appliances stacked outside, while disappointed former customers warn a newcomer away.
A committee splits into two hostile groups across a table, pulling the shared plan in opposite directions instead of cooperating.
A supposed helper carelessly ruins another person's finished painting with spilled water, leaving the painter distressed beside the damaged canvas.
A distrustful customer checks every coin before accepting change, watching the seller with narrowed eyes and a guarded posture.
An obsolete machine is disconnected and covered for disuse, with its power cable coiled safely away from the socket.
A disused railway platform has weeds between its tracks, rusted rails and an empty shelter with no passengers.
A divan has a long low upholstered seat, cushions along one side and no tall chair-like back.
A mediator divides a large loaf into two equal portions for waiting companions, with the knife placed safely beside the board.
A homeowner builds a simple bookshelf themselves, fitting the final board with a screwdriver beside the assembly pieces.
A child successfully lifts a manageable small watering can, while a much larger unusably heavy can remains beside it.
A court docket organizes separate case folders in a vertical sequence, with a clerk reviewing the next folder before the courtroom.
A nimble dodger ducks beneath a thrown soft ball, bending sideways while the ball passes safely overhead.
A guest doffs a hat on entering a home, lifting it clear of their head while greeting the host.
Two dogs quarrel over a rope toy, barking and tugging opposite ends while their handlers approach to separate them.
A spoon places one small dollop of thick cream onto a bowl of berries, leaving a soft rounded mound.
A dolomite specimen shows clusters of pale rhombohedral crystals on a rough matrix, with one detached crystal beside it.
A sorrowful adult sits beside a closed farewell letter and an empty chair, wiping a tear with a handkerchief.
A formerly outdoorsy adult settles into household life, cooking a meal and tending plants beside a comfortably organized family room.
A domineering ruler controls workers from a raised seat, holding all the workshop keys while others await instructions below.
A round door knob protrudes from a wooden door, with its spindle connection visible beside the door's latch edge.
A coarse doormat lies before a doorway, with muddy boots wiping their soles across its textured surface.
Two identical adults unexpectedly meet face to face, matching in features and clothing while both react with astonishment.
A mahi-mahi fish swims in profile, with a blunt high forehead, long dorsal fin and bright blue-green and yellow sides.
A foolish adult tries to put a large square box through a tiny round opening, ignoring an open doorway beside it.
A person sleeps peacefully in bed, eyes closed and breathing relaxed beneath a light blanket with the room quiet around them.
A doting grandparent showers a delighted child with affection, bringing several gifts while the child sits comfortably on their lap.
A wooden dovetail joint is shown partly assembled, with interlocking flared pins and matching sockets at the meeting corner.
Two wooden boards join through short cylindrical dowels, with one board separated slightly to reveal the matching drilled holes.
A road slopes steadily downhill past a roadside tree, with a cyclist coasting downward and the upper road receding behind.
A computer file is available for download, shown by a document picture and downward arrow leading into a local folder.
Smoke drifts downwind from a small campfire toward a distant tree, while a streamer confirms the same wind direction.
An excessively harsh supervisor punishes a tiny spill by making a worker scrub an enormous spotless floor, while others look dismayed.
A mayfly perches on a reed, showing delicate upright wings, a slender body and long trailing tail filaments.
Actors dramatize a story onstage while a director holds the original illustrated book, with the staged setting matching its picture.
Water drawdown exposes a broad muddy margin around a reservoir, with the former high-water stain visible on the bank.
A Dreadnought-style battleship has multiple large twin-gun turrets along its centerline, a heavy hull and early steam-era superstructure.
A dream world floats inside one sleeping person's thought bubble, containing impossible cloud bridges and a gently flying house.
An adult wears dressy evening clothes at a formal dinner, with polished shoes and a carefully fastened jacket.
A drifter floats on a small makeshift raft at sea, shading their eyes while searching the empty horizon.
A driver briefly stops at a roadside fruit stall, receiving a bag through the car window before continuing the journey.
A roadside drive-in restaurant has parked cars beside an open service window, with a server carrying a tray to one car.
A druggist organizes sealed medicine packages behind a pharmacy counter, consulting a customer's prescription without displaying readable drug names.
A drunken adult sits unsteadily beside an empty mug, hat askew and one hand gripping the table for balance.
A cut sheet of drywall reveals its pale gypsum core between thin paper faces, leaning beside a partly finished stud wall.
A hammer strikes a thick padded block dully, with little rebound and only small muted vibration marks at the contact.
A single dumbbell has two equal round weights joined by a short central grip, resting flat on a gym mat.
A large wheeled refuse dumpster has a hinged lid, side lifting pockets and several tied rubbish sacks inside.
A Dutch traveler holds a passport with the Netherlands' horizontal red-white-blue flag, beside a matching small travel pennant.
A livestock ear tag clips through a cow's ear, its blank rectangular marker clearly distinct from the natural ear shape.
A tethered balloon remains bound to the ground by a short rope and heavy anchor, unable to rise freely.
An earthenware cooking pot has a porous unglazed clay body, with a rough matte surface and thick rounded handles.
A simple map emphasizes a village on the eastern right side, with sunrise at the right horizon and a compass marker.
Three management echelons occupy clearly separated tiers in one organizational model, each upper tier supervising the next lower group.
A reusable cloth shopping bag carries loose vegetables, while the shopper refills a bottle instead of taking disposable packaging.
An unbleached linen cloth has a pale warm ecru color, folded loosely beside a white cotton swatch for comparison.
A child learns balance through a hands-on lever experiment, moving weights on a seesaw model while a teacher observes.
An egalitarian community shares equal food portions and identical seats around one round table, with no raised or privileged position.
A cup of creamy eggnog has a light frothy surface dusted with nutmeg, beside eggs, milk and a small grater.
A selfish diner takes the entire shared pie onto their own plate, leaving the other guests with empty dishes.
A self-centered guest monopolizes a conversation about themselves, pointing at their own portrait while bored companions try to speak.
An adult supplements a small soup portion by adding beans from another bowl, making the meal visibly more substantial.
An energetic expedition leader strides ahead with bright enthusiasm, lifting an arm toward the trail while companions follow eagerly.
An eligible voter places a folded ballot into a ballot box, holding their voter credential while waiting citizens queue behind.
A singer performs a mournful elegy beside a memorial portrait, with subdued listeners and a single white flower nearby.
An exclusive club admits only a small privileged group, while equally capable applicants are kept behind a barrier outside.
A sturdy wooden bracket forms a clear capital-L shape, with one vertical arm and one horizontal arm meeting at a right angle.
A single bold uppercase M is formed from four straight wooden strokes, standing alone as the complete subject.
Warm vapor emanates from a bowl of hot soup, rising outward in soft curling streams above the surface.
Defenders are surrounded inside a small fort, with opposing forces enclosing it on every side and no combat injuries shown.
An artisan embellishes a plain wooden box with a restrained border of carved leaves, leaving part of the lid undecorated.
Several glowing embers remain in a dark hearth, with red-orange interiors beneath gray ash and no tall flames.
An employee secretly embezzles coins from a company cash box, hiding them in a personal pocket while keeping the ledger open.
A coach emboldens a hesitant swimmer, standing supportively at the pool edge as the swimmer finally steps forward confidently.
A craftsperson embosses a flower design into leather, with the raised relief clearly visible beside the stamping tool.
A historical gun emplacement has a recessed protected platform and low parapet, with an inert cannon mounted centrally and no firing.
Two model builders compete to finish better bridges, each studying the other's work and improving their own structure.
